node.label: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity
node.definition: Activity of neuraminidase (EC 3.2.1.18)in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts. Neuraminidase is also known as lysosomal sialidase.

evidence.snippet: Neuraminidase deficiency: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
